title: Docker Compose & Networking
description: Work with multi-container applications using Docker Compose, manage data with volumes, and understand Docker networking and security.
longDescription: In this module you will learn to orchestrate multi-container applications with Docker Compose, persist data using volumes, understand Docker's networking model, and harden container images with security best practices. You'll also learn how to publish and manage images using Docker Hub.
whatYouLearn: Define and run multi-container applications with Docker Compose
Configure container networking and port publishing
Harden container images with security best practices
